biography.plain_text: Carsten von der Heyden is a Munich-area executive-search entrepreneur who founded VON DER HEYDEN Personalberatung in 1991. Over three decades, he developed a generalist recruitment practice centred on board and senior-management appointments. His firm has worked across software, telecommunications, infrastructure and logistics, and he remains its managing director within a wider group of family-linked businesses.

long_biography.plain_text:
Executive search has been Carsten von der Heyden's defining business. He describes personal interaction and trust earned over years as central to recruiting, and has emphasised long-term relationships with companies and candidates over purely transactional placement work.

A second family-led recruitment venture, VON DER HEYDEN Human Capital, was developed under his son Moritz to serve fast-growing technology companies. Von der Heyden has also managed an affiliated asset-management company handling related investment interests. Public registers identify him as managing director of the original consultancy, while Moritz took operating responsibility for Human Capital.
